title: Relecloud
sections: Relecloud is a travel booking company with its main office in Dublin and branch offices in Paris and Seattle. The company has 4,500 employees. The Microsoft 365 tenant was created in 2023, and its data is stored in the EU Data Boundary. Relecloud plans to expand Microsoft 365 Copilot from a pilot to the whole company during the next two quarters.

**Identity and licensing**

All users are synchronized from Active Directory Domain Services to Microsoft Entra ID. All employees have Microsoft 365 E5 licenses. The 600 members of a security group named AIPilot have Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses. A security group named LegalGroup contains the 40 members of the legal department.

**Devices and apps**

Office workers use Windows 11 devices that run Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise. Most devices are on Monthly Enterprise Channel. The call center in Seattle uses 150 shared devices that use device-based licensing for Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise. The marketing department uses Mac devices.

**Network**

All internet traffic passes through a proxy in the Dublin office. The proxy allows only a list of individual fully qualified domain names (FQDNs) and performs Transport Layer Security (TLS) inspection on all traffic. The network team plans to replace the proxy with a cloud-based secure web gateway next year.

**SharePoint**

Relecloud has 2,300 SharePoint sites. A site named HRRecords stores salary and performance review documents. An audit found that the Everyone except external users group was added to the Members group of HRRecords. SharePoint Advanced Management is available to the tenant through the Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses.

**Copilot Cowork**

The AI administrator enabled usage-based billing and created two spending policies in **Copilot** > **Cost Management** > **Configuration**:

- **Pilot policy**: scope is AIPilot, per-user limit is 3,000 Copilot credits, and the selected services are Copilot Chat and Cowork.
- **Org budget policy**: scope is All users, per-user limit is one Copilot credit, and the selected services are Copilot Chat and Cowork.

- Members of AIPilot must be able to use Claude models from Anthropic in the Microsoft Copilot app and in Researcher.
- Prompts and responses that are processed by Claude models must stay covered by the Microsoft Product Terms and the Microsoft Data Protection Addendum (DPA).
- Only members of AIPilot must be able to use Copilot Cowork during the pilot.
- The legal department must not use web search in any Copilot experience.
- For all other users, Copilot Chat must be able to use web search, but Researcher, Cowork, and Work mode must not send queries to the web.
- The company wants to know which users are ready for a Copilot license before the next purchase.

- Content from HRRecords must stop appearing in Copilot responses and in organization-wide search results while HR site owners review the permissions. Existing permissions must stay unchanged during the review.
- Copilot must work in the desktop apps and in the Copilot app on the Windows 11 devices.
- Use the least-privileged administrative role for each task.
- Minimize the number of policies that administrators must maintain.

- The network team will not replace the proxy before the Copilot rollout.
- Relecloud will not buy additional add-on licenses this fiscal year.
- Changes to the call center devices must be approved by the call center manager, who requires two weeks of notice.
